rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved mandatory courses plus general AMA Category I CME; limited credit for serving as monitoring/supervising physician and attending certain Board meetings (64B8-13.005 F.A.C.)
rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal: only HIV/AIDS (before first renewal), prevention of medical errors and, for DEA registrants, controlled substance prescribing.
rules.alternatives: Military exemption; volunteer indigent care or public school service can waive up to 25% of hours (not mandatory subjects); primary care physicians posting a price-transparency sign may be exempt for one cycle.

topics.who: Board-approved course before the first renewal

rules.notes: Licenses renew every 2 years: Group 1 expires Jan 31 of even years, Group 2 Jan 31 of odd years. Also must have practiced 2 of the last 4 years or pass SPEX. DOs licensed by separate Board of Osteopathic Medicine.
rules.rule_quote: Otherwise, you will be required to complete 40 hours of approved CME within the 24 months proceeding each biennial renewal period which consist of:…

rules.accepted_credit_types: At least 20 hours board-approved AOA Category 1-A (required courses count if AOA 1-A certified); max 8 home-study hours; max 6 hours for Board meeting attendance; up to 10 hours for pro-bono care in critical need areas (not as 1-A)
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed after July 1 of the odd year before the biennium ends: only laws & rules/ethics 1 h, medical errors 2 h, HIV/AIDS 1 h (before first renewal) and controlled substances 2 h (DEA registrants).

topics.who: Florida Laws & Rules / Professional and Medical Ethics

rules.notes: DOs are licensed by the Florida Board of Osteopathic Medicine. Biennium ends March 31 of even-numbered years. All CME must be reported in CE Broker before renewing.
